name: application-order-cart-drawer
title: Order Cart Drawer
description: Running food-order cart panel listing items with per-item modifiers and quantity, a computed subtotal, and a checkout button — distinct from checkout-order-summary, which is a full order-review/payment summary rather than an in-progress cart.
useWhen: Showing an in-progress food or product order with quantities and modifiers before checkout.
You want the subtotal computed live from real line-item quantity and price data.
A compact panel or drawer needs a persistent running total and a checkout call to action.
avoidWhen: You need a full payment/shipping review step — use checkout-order-summary instead.
Items have no modifiers or quantity — a simple list or table is simpler.
You need an animated slide-in drawer shell — pair this content with your own drawer/sheet primitive.
responsiveBehavior: The panel is fluid up to a max width and stacks item rows vertically; quantity badge, name/modifiers, and price stay on one row at all supported widths.
accessibility: The quantity badge is presented alongside the item name as text, not conveyed by size or color alone.
The subtotal and checkout button both display the same computed total so it's never ambiguous.
The checkout button has a visible focus ring for keyboard users.

variants.title: Order cart drawer
variants.description: A three-item food order with modifiers and quantities, a computed subtotal, and a checkout button, on a light surface.
accessibility: Subtotal is the real sum of quantity × price across all line items, not a hand-typed number.

variants.title: Order cart drawer (Dark)
variants.description: The same food order cart, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Text and badge colors meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
